what: Template rule prose for prop-fit-breakout and roster-walkforward still says 'a FAIL re-queues for a confirmatory run', but since #18593 (operator decision 2026-10-16, row RESEARCH-CONFIRM-FRESH-WINDOW) queue_grade closes a deterministic template cell's first FAIL with no same-window replay. Prose in research/templates/prop-fit-breakout.yaml (decision_rule.rule) and roster-walkforward.yaml (decision_rule.rule) disagrees with the grader (field beats comment).
